verdict.rationale: First-party docs show extensive AI-generated insight from user-uploaded sources inside the product. This includes grounded chat with inline citations, auto-generated source summaries, AI-suggested report types, mind maps, audio and video overviews, infographics, slide decks, and quizzes. Hands-on community reports confirm users get useful insight from it, such as studying material and listening to code walkthroughs. Missing for 10: proactive suggestions beyond AI-suggested report types (e.g., suggested follow-up questions or next steps) are only thinly evidenced.
